meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'казать'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to order', paired with 'заказывать'.

examples.text: Если опоздают, пицца бесплатно. Может, закажем?

meanings.note: Asks about the purpose. Core Russian adv meaning 'what for, why' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Oh, Samson. What have you come for?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('conquered, charmed').
